<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

    <clipPath id="screenClip">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" rx="35"/>

  </defs>

  <g clip-path="url(#screenClip)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1E1E1E"/>

    <!-- status bar -->
    <text x="24" y="27" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <g fill="#FFFFFF">
      <rect x="323" y="20" width="3" height="4" rx="1"/>

    </g>
    <circle cx="354" cy="25" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="369" y="15" width="18" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="17" width="13" height="7" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="388" y="18" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- subtle top utility controls -->
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="54" width="350" height="48" rx="24" fill="#2B2B2B" stroke="#363636" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="47" cy="78" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#A0A0A0" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="53.5" y1="84.5" x2="60" y2="91" stroke="#A0A0A0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="72" y="84" font-family="Inter" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#AAAAAA" opacity="0.65">Интеллект, в каждом слове...</text>
      <circle cx="345" cy="78" r="19" fill="#7A4FF4"/>
      <circle cx="345" cy="78" r="13" fill="#8779CC" opacity="0.45"/>
      <line x1="340" y1="78" x2="350" y2="78" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="345" y1="73" x2="345" y2="83" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <!-- animated frame 1: orbiting colored geometry -->
    <g opacity="1">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0;0;1" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <g transform="translate(195 300)">
        <rect x="-5" y="-126" width="10" height="40" rx="5" fill="#4285F4">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
        <rect x="-5" y="86" width="10" height="40" rx="5" fill="#EA4437">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
        <rect x="-126" y="-5" width="40" height="10" rx="5" fill="#FBBE0D">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
        <rect x="86" y="-5" width="40" height="10" rx="5" fill="#379D53">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="82" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="18" stroke-dasharray="112 36 64 42" opacity="0.98">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 -0 -0;360 0 0" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </circle>
        <rect x="8" y="-9" width="48" height="18" rx="4" fill="#4285F4"/>
        <rect x="38" y="-4" width="24" height="8" rx="4" fill="#4285F4"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- animated frame 2 -->
    <g opacity="0">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0;0" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <g transform="translate(195 300)">
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="105" fill="none" stroke="#4285F4" stroke-width="12" stroke-dasharray="42 180" opacity="0.95">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-30 0 0;330 0 0" dur="2.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </circle>
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#EA4437" stroke-width="12" stroke-dasharray="54 150" opacity="0.95">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="90 0 0;-270 0 0" dur="2.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </circle>
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="51" fill="none" stroke="#FBBE0D" stroke-width="12" stroke-dasharray="38 100" opacity="0.95">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="180 0 0;-180 0 0" dur="2.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </circle>
        <rect x="-15" y="-15" width="30" height="30" rx="8" fill="#379D53">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;90;180;270;360" dur="2.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- animated frame 3 -->
    <g opacity="0">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0;1;0" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <g transform="translate(195 300)">
        <rect x="-78" y="-78" width="48" height="48" rx="14" fill="#4285F4" transform="rotate(12)"/>
        <rect x="30" y="-72" width="48" height="48" rx="14" fill="#EA4437" transform="rotate(24)"/>
        <rect x="-70" y="30" width="48" height="48" rx="14" fill="#FBBE0D" transform="rotate(-18)"/>
        <rect x="30" y="30" width="48" height="48" rx="14" fill="#379D53" transform="rotate(14)"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
        <rect x="0" y="-10" width="65" height="20" rx="5" fill="#4285F4"/>
        <rect x="0" y="-10" width="20" height="20" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- loading status -->
    <g>
      <text x="195" y="447" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Обработка...</text>
      <rect x="98" y="466" width="194" height="5" rx="3" fill="#363636"/>
      <rect x="98" y="466" width="78" height="5" rx="3" fill="#7A4FF4">
        <animate attributeName="width" values="36;150;36" dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <animate attributeName="x" values="98;142;98" dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </rect>
      <circle cx="82" cy="468.5" r="3" fill="#4285F4">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.25;1;0.25" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </circle>
      <circle cx="308" cy="468.5" r="3" fill="#EA4437">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.25;1" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </circle>
    </g>

    <!-- partially visible white content panel -->
    <rect x="0" y="598" width="390" height="246" rx="30" fill="#000000" opacity="0.25" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <rect x="0" y="590" width="390" height="254" rx="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="24" y="612" width="58" height="6" rx="3" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="92" y="612" width="92" height="6" rx="3" fill="#EEEEEE"/>
    <rect x="194" y="612" width="74" height="6" rx="3" fill="#EEEEEE"/>
    <rect x="278" y="608" width="86" height="14" rx="7" fill="#EEEEEE"/>

    <rect x="24" y="645" width="342" height="54" rx="15" fill="#EEEEEE"/>
    <rect x="38" y="659" width="35" height="27" rx="8" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="670" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="40,682 49,673 55,679 61,674 70,686 40,686" fill="#A0A0A0"/>
    <rect x="87" y="658" width="122" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A0A0A0"/>
    <rect x="87" y="675" width="176" height="7" rx="3" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="291" y="661" width="52" height="21" rx="10" fill="#D9D9D9"/>

    <line x1="24" y1="719" x2="366" y2="719" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="24" y="739" width="164" height="9" rx="4" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="24" y="758" width="238" height="7" rx="3" fill="#EEEEEE"/>
    <rect x="24" y="777" width="194" height="7" rx="3" fill="#EEEEEE"/>

    <!-- bottom navigation -->
    <rect x="0" y="797" width="390" height="47" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <g stroke="#1E1E1E" stroke-width="2" fill="none">
      <polygon points="43,815 52,807 61,815 61,826 43,826"/>
      <polyline points="43,815 52,807 61,815"/>
      <circle cx="130" cy="814" r="8"/>
      <line x1="136" y1="820" x2="142" y2="826"/>
      <rect x="199" y="807" width="18" height="14" rx="4"/>
      <polygon points="203,821 207,826 211,821"/>

      <ellipse cx="288" cy="826" rx="12" ry="5"/>
      <circle cx="352" cy="809" r="2" fill="#1E1E1E"/>
      <circle cx="352" cy="816" r="2" fill="#1E1E1E"/>
      <circle cx="352" cy="823" r="2" fill="#1E1E1E"/>
    </g>
    <text x="52" y="841" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#1E1E1E">Главная</text>
    <text x="130" y="841" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#A0A0A0">Поиск</text>
    <text x="208" y="841" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#A0A0A0">Чаты</text>

    <text x="352" y="841" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#A0A0A0">Ещё</text>

</svg>
